desc: Tasks and calendar for any CalDAV server you supply (Radicale, Nextcloud, Baikal, Fastmail and others). Lasso handwriting in NOTE to capture it as a task, or create and edit tasks and events on device. Your task and event content, and the login you enter, are sent only to the server address you configure - no other destination. Settings are stored in Document/TaskHub/settings.json, and daily and meeting notes are created in folders you choose. Network access is used for your server; file read/write for those notes and settings.
name: Task Hub
author: Sparkinman
